issues.what: sub-line 'too hot for Sencha' about 30 px incl. descender in mid grey; at 1280 about 20 px, borderline

scenes.one_line: the key event is a 12 px seam on a 105 px bag; the colour bleed and wisps read, the opening does not

issues.what: 'OPEN' and 'brewing at 80 C' appear 0.3 s after the number and the status line is amber on dark, small (28 px caps)

scenes.one_line: the seal is nearly invisible; the one-liner is readable but sits 69 px from the bottom edge

issues.what: 'below 70 C, scent kept' about 30 px incl. descender in grey, at 1280 about 20 px
